task: Reconstruction of payment fraud approval model

observations.finding: The system produces an approval score between 0 and 1.
The decision is associated with the approval score.
Changing individual input fields changes the returned score.
The input fields can contain numerical and categorical values.

reconstruction_method.approach: Machine learning regression/classification model trained on collected black-box queries
reconstruction_method.training_data: Collected query inputs and corresponding black-box outputs
reconstruction_method.evaluation: Compare reconstructed predictions with observed black-box scores and decisions

limitations: The exact internal implementation of GK-03 is unknown.
The reconstruction approximates the observed black-box behavior.
